metaDescription: Your balances and recent money in and out, for every bank you have linked.
subtextAccounts_one: Here is the balance and recent activity of your {count} linked account.
subtextAccounts_other: Here are the balances and recent activity of your {count} linked accounts.
subtextEmpty: Connect a bank or upload a statement to get started.
noAccountsBody: Connect a bank or upload a statement to see your balance here.
openBreakdown: See the full list of spending
spendingEmpty: No money has gone out of this account yet.
combinedMissing: Not included: {currencies}. There is no published rate for it.
combinedSource: Converted at the European Central Bank's reference rate of {date}. Banks and money changers use their own rates, so treat this as a guide.
incomeAsk: How do you earn? Horizon reads your statements accordingly: a salary from your employer, a freelancer's uneven income, or pocket money that is never called a salary.
incomeSalary_one: {amount} a month: your salary from {payee}, seen in {count} month.
incomeSalary_other: {amount} a month: your salary from {payee}, seen in {count} months.
incomeCredits_one: About {amount} a month comes in, going by {count} full month of statements.
incomeCredits_other: About {amount} a month comes in, going by {count} full months of statements.
incomeDeclared: {amount} a month, as you told us. Your statements show about {seen} a month coming in.
incomeMismatch: That is a long way from the figure you gave: have a look at which is right.
incomeNoSalary: No salary credit found yet: add a statement that includes a pay day.
incomeNone: Nothing to go on yet: upload a statement.
checksIntro: A few quick questions make your charts and your income figure more accurate. Horizon only asks when it is not sure, and never asks the same thing twice.
checksLocked_one: {count} question is waiting. You have used your three free answers; subscribers answer as many as they like.
checksLocked_other: {count} questions are waiting. You have used your three free answers; subscribers answer as many as they like.
qOwnPair: On {date}, {amount} left {from} and arrived in {to}. Was that a transfer between your own accounts?
qOwnCredit: {amount} came in from {payee} on {date}. Is that your own money, moved from another account of yours?
qSalary: {amount} arrives from {payee} every month ({count} months so far). Is that your salary?
qRegular: {payee}: about {amount}, {cadence}, seen {count} times. What is it?
checksErrLocked: Your three free answers are used. Subscribe to answer more.
checksErrGone: That question is no longer there. Refresh the page.
healthNotYet: Not enough to say yet. Upload a few months of statements and tell Horizon how you earn, and the score appears here.
healthSavings: {percent} of the money that comes in stays with you (investments count as kept). A fifth or more is full marks.
healthEmi: {percent} of your income goes to EMIs. Up to 15% is full marks; beyond 40% is none.
healthCommitments: {percent} of your income is spoken for before the month starts: EMIs, rent, subscriptions and bills. Up to half is full marks.
healthCharges_one: {count} bank charge in the last {months} months. None is full marks.
healthCharges_other: {count} bank charges in the last {months} months. None is full marks.
healthCushion: Your balances would cover about {months} months of spending. Three months is full marks.
healthLockedText: Subscribers see the five parts of the score, the figure behind each, and what would raise it most.
incomeSideLabel: Side income a month, if any (freelance, rent you receive)
incomeSalaryPlus: {amount} a month: your salary from {payee} ({salary}) plus about {side} on the side, as you told us.
checksBarText_one: {count} payment needs a quick look. Until it is confirmed, your charts and income figure may be off.
checksBarText_other: {count} payments need a quick look. Until they are confirmed, your charts and income figure may be off.
checksPageIntro: Where your statements leave Horizon unsure, it asks. Each answer makes your charts and your income figure more accurate.
incomeEmployerLooking: Looking for your employer in your statements…
incomeEmployerFound_one: Found it: {payee} pays you {amount} a month, seen in {count} month. Horizon will read that as your salary.
incomeEmployerFound_other: Found it: {payee} pays you {amount} a month, seen in {count} months. Horizon will read that as your salary.
incomeEmployerNone: Horizon has not found a company paying you the same amount each month yet, so it cannot tell which credit is your salary. Upload a statement that includes a pay day, then pick this option again.
incomePayDayLabel: Which day of the month does your salary arrive? (1 to 31)
